purpose: Limited adversarial recheck of the corrected frozen four-team mixture; not a global Nash certificate.
selection: Highest lawful full-game score in existing 81k record (tied); stronger 27k result breaks the tie. No new tier sweep.
compute_note: same_budget shares 81k between attacker warmup/response; two opponent-policy queries cost an additional 2x81k. The attacker has more total compute.
blue: Actual ProtocolAgent/PlayerChannel, unchanged production prior, exact regenerated compiled preview index u32(seed)%64, default legacy argmax execution.
red: Public-history reconstruction and sampled hypothetical worlds only; public mixture weights are known, realized Blue type/selection/randomness is not. Preview best response targets the compiled distribution.
termination: Fixed 32 blocks; no optional stopping or result-driven tuning. Natural ties and turn caps both score 0.5, with capped turns retained.
inference: Paired block mean, standard error and approximate 95% interval, plus conservative one-sided Hoeffding upper bound. A failure to detect a gain is not a Nash proof.
